Instrument (EN): Perceived Stress Scale — Spanish nursing student 14-item psychometric re-evaluation
Scales / measured domains (EN): Perceived Helplessness; Perceived Self-Efficacy (two correlated factors); total perceived stress
Research provenance: García-Martínez et al., J Psychiatr Ment Health Nurs, 2026-04-30; n=1133 Spanish nursing students; PSS-14 parent administered; 10- and 4-item scores are subsets of same responses. Cortisol AUC explored in subset n=33, not diagnostic validity. Two-factor CE models studied.
DB locales: Base PSS keys research-indexed; distinct ES-ES nursing cohort/source-edition not a published app assessment version.
EN form: Original English PSS-14 exists; this paper does NOT create an EN version or validate English respondents.
RU form: RU: no validated RU form from this Spanish study.
ES form: ES-ES: Existing Spanish respondent wording empirically re-examined in one n=1133 student cohort; NOT a new Spanish translation.
Other translations: No separately validated additional locale from this study.
Target population: Spanish university nursing students, n=1133; salivary cortisol subsample n=33.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: Carnegie Mellon directs PSS permission requests through MAPI Research Trust ePROVIDE; non-profit academic exemptions do not establish commercial digital app rights. Obtain version-and-locale-specific written permission.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY; no public questionnaire item text or scores; AUC low and biomarker n=33; do not use cortisol-derived cutoffs as diagnostic.

Research provenance: Same García-Martínez 2026 cohort n1133; ten PSS-10 items derived from 14-item administration, NOT standalone independent 10-item validation; strong internal consistency and invariance; cortisol AUC for total score .546 in n33 only.
DB locales: Base PSS-10 already in research registry; this is NEW study/locale/population evidence only, not new instrument or published ES version.
EN form: Original EN PSS-10 exists; no new validation of EN-language administration in this study.
RU form: RU: no validated respondent-language evidence from this study.
ES form: ES-ES: Pre-existing Spanish PSS-10 subset evaluated in n1133; NOT a new translation; derived from administered PSS-14.
Other translations: No independently evaluated new other locale.
Target population: Spanish university nursing students, n=1133; morning cortisol n=33.
Commercial digital use / permission revi: PSS requests through MAPI ePROVIDE per Carnegie Mellon. Commercial digital hosting, full respondent item reproduction, Spanish electronic copy and automated scoring require permission review.
Verification notes / safety gate: RESEARCH_ONLY; validation from a longer-form administration may not generalize to separate short questionnaire; PSS not diagnostic and has no universal stress cutoffs.
